_comment: Portable + committable: 'node' resolves on every OS, and the script path is RELATIVE to the workspace root (where this file lives), so it works on Windows/macOS/Linux without per-machine edits. mcp-graph.js self-boots the daemon and defaults its workspace to cwd, so no absolute ORCH_WORKSPACE is needed. For a GLOBAL install (orchestrator under ~/.claude/orchestrator, used across many workspaces) run 'node bin/install.js' to generate an absolute-path .mcp.json instead.
